# ADPS PICKS

> AI-curated online select shop for Japan.

ADPS PICKS is an online store that curates products across categories such as gadgets, pet supplies, kitchen tools, travel goods, golf and lifestyle products.

## Core concept

- AI-curated selection rather than a single fixed product category
- Japan-first commerce experience
- Discovery-oriented collections such as Today's Picks, Trending Now, Under ¥3,000, Problem Solvers and Oddly Good
- Product pages explain why an item was selected
- Price, stock, shipping and return information should be treated as authoritative only when sourced from the live Shopify product and checkout data

## Important pages

- Storefront preview: https://ai-buyer-nine.vercel.app/shop

## Product information policy

Demo product names, prices, ratings and availability on the current prototype are not authoritative production commerce data.
The storefront remains noindex until real Shopify product data is connected.
When production indexing is enabled, structured product data must match the visible Shopify product data exactly.

## About AI selection

ADPS evaluates signals such as trend momentum, price accessibility, usability, review tendencies, shipping conditions and how clearly a product's value can be understood.

## Language and market

Primary launch market: Japan
Primary language: Japanese
Future markets may be added only when product-level shipping, regulations and support requirements are verified.
